headline: CIN @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 4.35 at CLE 4.94, with a projected total of 9.28. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: CIN moved +0.12 runs while CLE moved -0.79, changing the projected margin by +0.91 runs. The projected total fell -0.66, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -20.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Joey Cantillo has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for JJ Bleday, Spencer Steer, Elly De La Cruz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rhys Hoskins because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
